name: Tencent Hunyuan 3D Pro (Tencent Cloud TC3)
description: Tencent Cloud TC3-signed Hunyuan 3D Pro preset. Enter SecretId:SecretKey after importing.

connectors.name: Tencent Hunyuan 3D Pro
connectors.request_template: {"Model":"{{ model }}","GenerateType":"{{ GenerateType | default('Normal') }}","EnablePBR":{{ EnablePBR | default(false) | tojson }},"FaceCount":{{ FaceCount | default(500000) }}{% if (GenerateType | default('Normal')) == 'LowPoly' %},"PolygonType":"{{ PolygonType | default('triangle') }}"{% endif %},"ResultFormat":"{{ ResultFormat | default('GLB') }}"{% if image_url %},"ImageUrl":"{{ image_url }}"{% elif image_base64 %},"ImageBase64":"{{ image_base64 }}"{% else %},"Prompt":"{{ prompt }}"{% endif %}}
connectors.description: Supports text-to-3D, Asset Hub image-to-3D, face count, generation type, PBR material, polygon topology, and result format. Model 3.1 does not support LowPoly. API Key format: SecretId:SecretKey.
